```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(patchwork)
  library(ape)
})

# Set working directory and upload data

## Trait data

setwd("//wsl.localhost/Ubuntu/home/gianl/piezo1_pipeline/data_analysis/excel_sheets/COMBINE_dataset/")

trait_data <- read_csv("trait_data_reported.csv") %>%
  mutate(
    species = gsub(" ", "_", species),
    adult_mass_g = as.numeric(adult_mass_g),
    log10_body_mass_g = log10(adult_mass_g)
  )

## QE data

setwd("//wsl.localhost/Ubuntu/home/gianl/piezo1_pipeline/data_analysis/PGLS_data/")

QE_data <- bind_rows(
  read_tsv("primates_QE_regions_290426.tsv") %>% mutate(order = "Primates"),
  read_tsv("rodentia_QE_regions_290426.tsv") %>% mutate(order = "Rodentia"),
  read_tsv("carnivora_QE_regions_290426.tsv") %>% mutate(order = "Carnivora"),
  read_tsv("cetartiodactyla_QE_regions_290426.tsv") %>% mutate(order = "Cetartiodactyla")
)

### Pivot QE data wide

QE_data <- QE_data %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(species, order),
    names_from = region,
    values_from = c(E_count, QE_sum, E_ratio, Neg_charge, Net_charge, Net_charge_no_H)
  )


# COMBINE dataset contains multiple entries for traits
# Deduplication was carried out by calculating the sum of multiple body mass entries

trait_data <- trait_data %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(
    family = first(na.omit(family)),
    marine = first(na.omit(marine)),
    log10_body_mass_g = mean(log10_body_mass_g, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Merge trait and QE data

final_dataset <- QE_data %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    trait_data %>% dplyr::select(c("species", "family", "log10_body_mass_g", "marine")),
    by = "species"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(species, order, family, marine,
                starts_with("QE_sum"),
                starts_with("E_count"),
                starts_with("E_ratio"),
                starts_with("Neg_charge"),
                starts_with("Net_charge"),
                log10_body_mass_g
                ) %>%
  mutate(
    E_sum_total = E_count_QE_region_1 + E_count_QE_region_2 + E_count_QE_region_3,
    QE_sum_total = QE_sum_QE_region_1 + QE_sum_QE_region_2 + QE_sum_QE_region_3
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# Many species do not have a body mass entry and family in COMBINE
# To fill in missing values for some species values from different databases or closely related species in COMBINE were used. (see supp. Excel sheet)

final_dataset %>% filter(is.na(log10_body_mass_g)) %>% pull(species)

final_dataset <- final_dataset %>%
  mutate(
    log10_body_mass_g = case_when(
      species == "Cercopithecus_albogularis" ~ log10(5280), #
      species == "Plecturocebus_cupreus" ~ log10(1070),
      species == "Nomascus_annamensis" ~ log10(7000),
      species == "Cephalopachus_bancanus" ~ log10(120),
      species == "Cebus_imitator" ~ log10(3220),
      species == "Cricetomys_ansorgei" ~ log10(1400),
      species == "Tamias_sibiricus" ~ log10(94.15),
      species == "Cavia_porcellus" ~ log10(399),
      species == "Spilogale_interrupta" ~ log10(612),
      species == "Neogale_vison" ~ log10(1075),
      species == "Felis_catus" ~ log10(2884.8),
      species == "Bos_taurus" ~ log10(618642.42),
      species == "Capra_hircus" ~ log10(47386.47),
      species == "Ovis_aries" ~ log10(39097.89),
      species == "Bubalus_bubalis" ~ log10(929500.97),
      species == "Vicugna_pacos" ~ log10(50000),
      species == "Camelus_bactrianus" ~ log10(554515.91),
      species == "Giraffa_tippelskirchi" ~ log10(800000),
      species == "Lama_glama" ~ log10(115000),
      
      TRUE ~ log10_body_mass_g
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    family = case_when(
      species == "Cercopithecus_albogularis" ~ "Cercopithecidae",
      species == "Plecturocebus_cupreus" ~ "Pitheciidae",
      species == "Nomascus_annamensis" ~ "Hylobatidae",
      species == "Cephalopachus_bancanus" ~ "Tarsiidae",
      species == "Cebus_imitator" ~ "Cebidae",
      species == "Cricetomys_ansorgei" ~ "Nesomyidae",
      species == "Tamias_sibiricus" ~ "Sciuridae",
      species == "Cavia_porcellus" ~ "Caviidae",
      species == "Spilogale_interrupta" ~ "Mephitidae",
      species == "Neogale_vison" ~ "Mustelidae",
      species == "Felis_catus" ~ "Felidae",
      species == "Bos_taurus" ~ "Bovidae",
      species == "Capra_hircus" ~ "Bovidae",
      species == "Ovis_aries" ~ "Bovidae",
      species == "Bubalus_bubalis" ~ "Bovidae",
      species == "Balaenoptera_ricei" ~ "Balaenopteridae",
      species == "Vicugna_pacos" ~ "Camelidae",
      species == "Camelus_bactrianus" ~ "Camelidae",
      species == "Giraffa_tippelskirchi" ~ "Giraffidae",
      species == "Lama_glama" ~ "Camelidae",
      TRUE ~ family
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    marine = ifelse(is.na(marine), 0, marine)
    )
    
  
# Add DPG sensitivity variables

DPG_binary_list <- c("Felidae", "Viverridae", "Herpestidae", "Hyaenidae", "Eupleridae", "Nandiniidae", "Bovidae", "Cervidae", "Giraffidae", "Antilocapridae", "Moschidae", "Tragulidae")

## Binary categorisation

final_dataset <- final_dataset %>%
  mutate(
    DPG_binary = ifelse(
      family %in% DPG_binary_list, 1, 0
      )
    )

## Distinguish between groups

DPG_feliformia <- c("Felidae", "Viverridae", "Herpestidae", "Hyaenidae", "Eupleridae", "Nandiniidae")
  
DPG_ruminantia <- c("Bovidae", "Cervidae", "Giraffidae", "Antilocapridae", "Moschidae", "Tragulidae")

final_dataset <- final_dataset %>%
  mutate(
    DPG_non_binary = case_when(
      family %in% DPG_feliformia ~ "Feliformia",
      family %in% DPG_ruminantia ~ "Ruminantia",
      TRUE ~ "Sensitive"
    )
  )

# Add P50 and MS-BMR from Udroiu (2023)

## Get data

setwd("//wsl.localhost/Ubuntu/home/gianl/piezo1_pipeline/data_analysis/excel_sheets/")

udroiu_dt <- read.csv("Udroiu2023.csv", fileEncoding = "latin1") %>%
  rename_with(tolower) %>%
  mutate(species = gsub(" ", "_", species)) %>%
  filter(species != "") %>%
  distinct(species, .keep_all = TRUE)

## Merge with dataset

final_dataset <- final_dataset %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    udroiu_dt %>% dplyr::select(species, ms.bmr..w.g., hbp50..ph7.2.20.c.),
    by = "species"
  )

final_dataset %>%
  group_by(order) %>%
  summarise(
    total = n(),
    has_p50 = sum(!is.na(hbp50..ph7.2.20.c.)),
    pct = round(100*has_p50 / total)
  )


# Harmonise names species to phylogeny's nomenclature (Based on synonyms or closest relative present on Mammal Diversity Database, https://www.mammaldiversity.org/ as of 04.05.26). Drop 

phylo_synonyms <- tribble(
   ~data_name,                  ~tree_name,
  "Alexandromys_fortis",       "Microtus_fortis",
  "Physeter_macrocephalus",    "Physeter_catodon",
  "Mustela_putorius",           "Mustela_putorius_furo",
  "Eulemur_collaris",          "Eulemur_fulvus_collaris",
  "Nomascus_annamensis",       "Nomascus_gabriellae",
  "Spilogale_interrupta",      "Spilogale_gracilis"
)

final_dataset <- final_dataset %>%
  left_join(phylo_synonyms, by = c("species" = "data_name")) %>%
  mutate(species = coalesce(tree_name, species)) %>%
  select(-tree_name)

## Determine species that will be dropped for each order when using compartive.data function of caper.

phy_tree <- read.tree(file.path("//wsl.localhost/Ubuntu/home/gianl/piezo1_pipeline/data_analysis", "PGLS_data/phylo_trees/all_species_timetree.nwk"))

dropped_table <- final_dataset %>% 
  filter(!species %in% phy_tree$tip.label) %>%
  select(species, order, family, log10_body_mass_g) %>%
  arrange(order, species)

write.csv(
  dropped_table,
  file = "//wsl.localhost/Ubuntu/home/gianl/piezo1_pipeline/data_analysis/TableSX_species_dropped_from_phylogeny.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)



write.csv(final_dataset,
          file.path("//wsl.localhost/Ubuntu/home/gianl/piezo1_pipeline/data_analysis/",
                    "main_dataset.csv"))
```

# Per-order × per-region summary table for all metrics
```{r}
orders <- c("Primates", "Carnivora", "Rodentia", "Cetartiodactyla")

qe_summary <- final_dataset %>%
  filter(order %in% orders) %>%
  select(species, order,
         starts_with("E_count_QE_region_"),
         starts_with("QE_sum_QE_region_"),
         starts_with("E_ratio_QE_region_"),
         starts_with("Neg_charge_QE_region_"),
         starts_with("Net_charge_QE_region_"),
         starts_with("Net_charge_no_H_QE_region_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(species, order),
    names_to = c("metric", "region"),
    names_pattern = "(E_count|QE_sum|E_ratio|Neg_charge|Net_charge_no_H|Net_charge)_QE_region_(\\d)",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  group_by(metric, region, order) %>%
  summarise(
    n    = n(),
    mean = round(mean(value), 2),
    sd   = round(sd(value), 2),
    min  = round(min(value), 2),
    max  = round(max(value), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(metric, region, order)

print(qe_summary, n = Inf)

write.csv(
  qe_summary,
  file = "//wsl.localhost/Ubuntu/home/gianl/piezo1_pipeline/data_analysis/TableSX_QE_distribution_summary:untrimmed.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

```

# Check for distribution of weight data (supplementary data analysis)

```{r}
bm_data <- final_dataset %>%
  filter(order %in% orders, !is.na(log10_body_mass_g)) %>%
  mutate(order = factor(order, levels = orders))

# Extract sample size per order for visualisation
n_per_order <- bm_data %>%
  count(order) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(order, " (n = ", n, ")"))

bm_data <- bm_data %>% 
  left_join(n_per_order %>% select(order, label), by = "order") %>%
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = n_per_order$label))

# Raw scale
p_raw <- ggplot(bm_data, aes(x = 10^log10_body_mass_g)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 25, 
                 fill = "steelblue", 
                 color = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~label, 
             scales = "free",
             ncol = 4) +
  labs(x = "Body mass (g)", 
       y = "Count", 
       title = "Raw scale") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_blank()
  )

p_log <- ggplot(bm_data, aes(x = log10_body_mass_g)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 25, 
                 fill = "steelblue", 
                 color = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~label, 
             scales = "free", 
             ncol = 4) +
  labs(x = expression(log[10] ~ body ~ mass ~ (g)),
       y = "Count",
       title = "Log-transformed") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_blank()
  )

# Combined histogram plots

bm_distribution_plot <- p_raw / p_log +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Distribution of body mass across selected mammalian orders",
    subtitle = "Right-skewed raw distributions are normalised by log10-transformation",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13)
    )
  )

print(bm_distribution_plot)

plot_path <- "//wsl.localhost/Ubuntu/home/gianl/piezo1_pipeline/data_analysis/plots"

ggsave("FigSX_body_mass_distr_all_orders.png",
       plot = bm_distribution_plot,
       path = plot_path,
       width = 14, height = 7, dpi = 600)

```
